description: Deterministic connector healing and full visual re-rendering ($0 compute cost, instant, unlimited). Cleans exact duplicate edges and empty sequence labels, recomputes deterministic orthogonal layout, and returns fresh `spec`, `svg`, `mermaid`, `excalidraw`, and `studioUrl`. Missing steps or branches require source-backed edits to the spec; this tool preserves graph meaning and does not perform semantic verification. Use this tool after making direct structural edits to `VisualSpec` JSON (`nodes` / `edges`), or when a user asks to autofix connectors.

authToken.description: Optional session token (`utok_...`) if not passed via Authorization header.

evidenceCoverage.description: Optional document preflight coverage report from the host agent (`pagesExamined`, `totalPages`, `textExtracted`, `tablesExtracted`, `embeddedDiagramsDetected`, `omittedMedia`, `notes`). When omitted media or uninspected diagrams are reported, Unseen flags `EVIDENCE_NOT_INSPECTED`.

includeExcalidraw.description: Explicitly include or omit inline Excalidraw scene JSON (defaults to true only for 'full').

includeSvg.description: Explicitly include or omit inline SVG XML (defaults to true for 'full' and 'svg', false for 'preview'/'compact'/'mermaid').

maxPreviewHeight.description: Target preview height bound in px for responsive preview metadata (default 900).

maxPreviewWidth.description: Target preview width bound in px for responsive preview metadata (default 1200).

orientation.description: Optional layout orientation (defaults to topology auto-orientation). Mermaid emits TD for portrait or LR for landscape; the host controls final geometry.

renderFormat.description: Optional output size control (MCP defaults to 'mermaid' for the host to render). Use 'preview' for a bounded inline PNG on the hosted service, with Mermaid and an owner-only SVG URL when available, or 'svg'/'mermaid' for a single format.

spec.description: The VisualSpec JSON object to deterministically heal and re-render into SVG, Mermaid, and Excalidraw.

swimlane.description: Optional swimlane layout toggle (defaults to automatic swimlanes when 2+ actor groups exist).

visualId.description: Owned jobId or visualId of the original workflow, to carry its document evidence coverage forward.

name: autofix_workflow
title: Autofix & Re-Render Workflow ($0 Free)
